description: Prepare a group e-mail (draft, nothing is sent yet). Required: name, subject, body (plain text), and recipients: saved_filter_id, filter (as in search_crm) or ids — entity contacts (default) or accounts. Placeholders: {{briefanrede}} (e.g. 'Sehr geehrte Frau Dr. Mustermann,'), {{vorname}}, {{nachname}}, {{name}}, {{anrede}}, {{titel}}, {{email}}, {{telefon}}, {{position}}, {{organisation}}, {{strasse}}, {{plz}}, {{ort}}, {{land}}, {{zf_<key>}} for custom fields; {{#if feld}}…{{/if}} works. Every mail gets an unsubscribe link automatically. purpose (default newsletter) is checked against each person's consent; revoked or blocked people are skipped. Optional: from_email (a connected mailbox), from_name, reply_to or as_me=true (your name as sender, replies to you), attachments (document_ids), attachment_mode link|file. Then preview_group_mailing, send_group_mailing_test, schedule_group_mailing.

as_me.description: Send with your name as sender; replies go to you

attachment_mode.description: How attachments are delivered: link or file

filter.description: Recipient filter as in search_crm (alternative to saved_filter_id or ids)

ids.description: Explicit recipient record IDs (alternative to saved_filter_id or filter)

purpose.description: Consent purpose checked per recipient (default newsletter)

name: create_group_mailing
